name: bmad-fr-nfr-review-gate
description: Codex entrypoint for post-implementation BMAD FR/NFR review gates. Use after a PR, feature, or bugfix has BMAD specs and must be checked against every functional requirement, non-functional requirement, expanded quality dimension, Wikipedia system quality attribute, generated positive/negative/ edge test case, automated test and CI coverage expectation, flaky-test risk, whole-codebase impact surface, manual-test expectation, GitHub review comments and requested-changes state, and CI check before completion.
